gw_in_vless.err.bad_key: the VLESS server key is damaged (vless.server.private) — change the keys: kaskadctl gw vless rekey --yes
gw_in_vless.why.no_python_tls13: Python on this server can’t do TLS 1.3 ({error})
gw_in_vless.why.no_tls13: the site doesn’t answer over TLS 1.3
gw_in_vless.why.timeout: the site didn’t answer within {sec} s
gw_in_vless.why.unreachable: the site is unreachable from the server ({error})
gw_in_vless.why.old_tls: the site answered with {tls}, but TLS 1.3 is needed
gw_in_vless.err.tls_mode: VLESS runs in TLS mode with its own domain — it needs no masking site: all other requests open the server’s site.
gw_in_vless.err.none_tls13: No site from the list answered the server over TLS 1.3 ({why}). Check that the server can reach the internet.
gw_in_vless.err.no_own_site: The server has no site of its own: “own site” works in “site” mode (menu “Domain and site”).
gw_in_vless.err.own_on_443: VLESS on port 443 answers for the site itself: “own site” for Reality works only on another port (change the VLESS port first).
gw_in_vless.err.bad_host: A masking site is a name like www.example.com, not {value}.
gw_in_vless.err.unfit: {host} isn’t suitable as a masking site: {why}.
gw_in_vless.log.tls_copy_failed: couldn’t write the copy of the domain certificate for xray: {error}
gw_in_vless.log.tls_copied: domain certificate handed to the gateway’s xray (it rereads it on its own, no restart)
gw_in_vless.note.tls_mode: TLS mode with own domain {domain}: VLESS on 443, all other requests open the server’s site
gw_in_vless.note.mask_bad: masking site — {sni}, but it didn’t answer the server over TLS 1.3 ({why}): choose another site
gw_in_vless.note.no_domain: No domain — the backup Reality. To get TLS: add a domain in “Settings → Domain and site”
gw_in_vless.note.wait_cert: Waiting for the certificate of {domain} — the backup Reality for now
gw_in_vless.warn.xray_down: the gateway’s xray isn’t running — the VLESS protocol accepts no connections (kaskadctl gw apply shows why)
gw_in_vless.warn.not_listening: the gateway’s xray is running, but port {port}/tcp isn’t listening — the VLESS protocol accepts no connections (kaskadctl gw apply shows why)
gw_in_vless.warn.idle: no devices use the VLESS protocol yet
gw_in_vless.err.not_user: Device {device} doesn’t use the VLESS protocol, is turned off, or has no key yet (kaskadctl gw apply).
gw_in_vless.apps: Apps: v2RayTun, Hiddify, Streisand, v2rayN, NekoBox.
gw_in_vless.link_private: Don’t share the link with others: it holds this device’s key.
gw_in_vless.qr_note: In the app, tap “+” and scan this QR code.
gw_in_vless.route_note: Traffic follows the device’s route and the server’s routing rules, as with other protocols.
gw_in_vless.log.consent_bad: VLESS: Reality is chosen with a domain, but the consent to the risks is missing or outdated — the mode is unchanged
gw_in_vless.fix.domain: Add a domain: Settings → Domain and site
gw_in_vless.fix.cert: Issue the domain certificate: Settings → Domain and site
gw_in_vless.fix.free_443: Free port 443: another program or site holds it
gw_in_vless.fix.panel_port: Move the panel’s open mode to a port of its own: Settings → Panel
gw_in_vless.fix.site_on: Turn on the site on the domain
gw_in_vless.fix.consent: Confirm Reality or switch to TLS
gw_in_vless.recommend: You can switch to TLS with your own domain. The price: the VLESS keys have to be given out again ({n} device).|You can switch to TLS with your own domain. The price: the VLESS keys have to be given out again ({n} devices).
gw_in_vless.recommend_free: You can switch to TLS with your own domain: no devices use VLESS, nobody needs new keys.
gw_in_vless.recommend_site: You can switch to TLS with your own domain. {price}
gw_in_vless.consent.a.title: Reality instead of your own certificate
gw_in_vless.consent.a.tail: Sometimes Reality gets through where your own domain is not let in (for example, mobile “allow lists”). If that is why you choose it, choose it knowingly.
gw_in_vless.consent.b.title: Reality with your own site instead of the certificate
gw_in_vless.consent.b.tail: Choose it if TLS with your own certificate does not get through for your users and Reality does.
gw_in_vless.consent.price: the links given out now will stop working — they have to be given out again ({n} device).|the links given out now will stop working — they have to be given out again ({n} devices).
gw_in_vless.consent.price_same: the links given out now stay the same.
gw_in_vless.consent.phrase: I understand the risks, choose Reality
gw_in_vless.consent.short.a: Reality makes the server pose as another site ({site}) and depends on it; with a domain, TLS with your own certificate is more reliable.
gw_in_vless.consent.short.b: Reality with your own site moves VLESS off 443 to port {port}; with a domain, TLS is more reliable.
gw_in_vless.busy: The VLESS mode is being changed (started {at}) — try again when it is done
gw_in_vless.busy_now: The VLESS mode is being changed — try again when it is done
gw_in_vless.recover_failed_entry: An interrupted change of the VLESS mode was not undone: {why}. Try again or run: kaskadctl gw vless mode --recover
gw_in_vless.pending_left: An interrupted change of the VLESS mode is not undone yet — first run: kaskadctl gw vless mode --recover
gw_in_vless.interrupted: the change of the mode was interrupted ({at})
gw_in_vless.log.recover_failed: VLESS: an interrupted change of the mode was not undone: {why}
gw_in_vless.log.recovered: VLESS: an interrupted change of the mode ({at}) was undone — everything as it was
gw_in_vless.price_tls: VLESS will switch to TLS with your own domain. The VLESS links given before will stop working. Give them again — devices: {n} ({who}). Subscriptions update by themselves on the next refresh in the app.
gw_in_vless.price_reality: VLESS will switch to Reality (site {site}, port {port}). The VLESS links given before will stop working. Give them again — devices: {n} ({who}).
gw_in_vless.tls_undone: TLS did not start: {why}. Nothing changed — VLESS works as before.
gw_in_vless.undo_failed: TLS did not start ({why}), and the undo failed: {err}. Run: kaskadctl gw vless mode --recover
gw_in_vless.log.tls_undone: VLESS: the switch to TLS failed ({why}) — undone, everything as it was (via: {via}, by: {who})
gw_in_vless.log.to_tls: VLESS: switched to TLS with the own domain (via: {via}, by: {who}); to give out again: {n}
gw_in_vless.need_consent: Reality with a domain needs a consent to its risks. Show this text to the person; the consent: --accept-risks (MCP — the phrase in accept_risks, risks and site from data).
gw_in_vless.risks_changed: The text of the risks or the site do not match the current ones — show the new text and pass risks and site from data
gw_in_vless.pick_first: Pick the cover site first (gw vless masks --check) and name it in the text of the risks
gw_in_vless.reality_already: Reality is on already: {why}. To change the cover site, give --site
gw_in_vless.choice_not_written: The choice of Reality is not recorded — the server will switch to TLS when it can. To stay on Reality then too — --accept-risks
gw_in_vless.nothing_pending: No interrupted change of the mode
gw_in_vless.recovered: The interrupted change of the mode was undone — everything as it was
gw_in_vless.bad_mode: The VLESS mode is tls or reality, not {mode}
gw_in_vless.log.reality_consent: VLESS: Reality with a domain chosen with a consent to the risks ({risks}, site {site}; via: {via}, by: {who})
gw_in_vless.log.nodomain: VLESS: Reality chosen without a domain (via: {via}, by: {who})
gw_in_vless.sync_legacy_recommend: TLS with your own domain is possible, but the VLESS links will change: devices {n} ({who}). The mode does not change without your decision — to switch: «VLESS mode» → TLS (gw vless mode tls).
gw_in_vless.log.consent_b_gone: VLESS: the consent to Reality was given for the own site, and the cover site became a foreign one — the consent removed, the choice is «TLS» (Reality while TLS is impossible)
gw_in_vless.mask_consent_a: The consent to Reality was given for the own site. A foreign cover site has other risks: show the human this text; the consent: --accept-risks (MCP — the phrase in accept_risks, risks from data).
gw_in_vless.log.mask_consent: VLESS: a new consent to the risks of Reality with the foreign site {site} (via: {via}, who: {who})
